en: a. relating to the human spirit or soul rather than the body; relating to religion; having deep feelings and thoughts about the meaning of life; n. a religious song, especially one from African American tradition
ex: Many people turn to meditation for spiritual growth.
許多人透過冥想來追求心靈成長。

en: a. covered with a thin layer of dust; (of an old book or subject) not interesting; (of a color) looking pale or gray; (of a soil) dry and powdery
ex: The old books on the shelf were dusty from years of neglect.
架上的舊書多年沒人理會，積滿了灰塵。

en: a. very interested and enthusiastic about something; very sharp or quick to notice; (of a blade) very sharp; (of a feeling) strong; n. a loud cry of grief at a funeral; vi. to cry loudly in grief
ex: She is keen on learning new languages.
她熱衷於學習新語言。

en: vt. to make something stronger or more effective; to become stronger or more firm; vi. to become stronger
ex: Regular exercise will strengthen your muscles.
規律運動能增強你的肌肉。

en: n. a person who sees something happen, especially a crime or accident; a person who gives evidence in a court of law; evidence or proof; vt. to see something happen; to sign a document to prove it is genuine; vi. to give evidence
ex: A witness described what she saw to the police.
一位目擊者向警方描述她所看到的情況。

en: a. relating to a particular race or cultural group; relating to the customs of a particular cultural group; (of food or clothing) typical of a particular culture
ex: The city has a diverse ethnic population.
這座城市的族群組成多元。

en: n. an object sent into space to travel around the Earth, used for communications or collecting information; a country that depends on a larger, more powerful country; a. depending on another larger body
ex: The satellite sends television signals around the world.
衛星把電視訊號傳送到世界各地。

en: vi. to come out from a hidden or unknown place; to become known or noticed; (of facts) to become known after being hidden; to come out of a difficult situation
ex: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
太陽從雲層後露了出來。

en: n. a love affair; a story about love; a feeling of excitement connected with love or adventure; a medieval story of heroes and adventures; vi. to write or talk about exciting events in a way that is not true
ex: Their romance began when they met in college.
他們的戀情始於大學時代的相遇。

en: n. a large special meal for many people to celebrate something; a religious festival; something very enjoyable; vt. to give a big meal for someone; vi. to eat and drink a lot of good food
ex: They held a feast to celebrate the harvest.
他們舉辦盛宴慶祝豐收。

en: n. a group of people who join together for a particular purpose; a connection or relationship between people or things; a link in the mind between two ideas
ex: She is a member of the National Teachers Association.
她是全國教師協會的會員。

en: n. a person who is trying to be chosen for a job or in an election; a person taking an exam; someone who is likely to win something
ex: Each candidate has to give a short speech.
每位候選人都得發表簡短演講。

en: n. the line far away where the sky seems to meet the land or sea; the limit of someone's knowledge or experience; the range of what someone can see or understand
ex: The sun slowly sank below the horizon.
太陽緩緩沉入地平線下。

en: a. extremely large in size, amount or degree; (informal) very great; covering a very large area
ex: The desert stretched out in a vast expanse of sand.
沙漠綿延成一片遼闊的沙地。

en: a. (of a woman or female animal) having a baby or young developing inside her body; full of meaning or importance; (of a pause or silence) full of unspoken meaning
ex: She is five months pregnant and expecting a girl.
她懷孕五個月，預計生女孩。

en: n. a result or effect of something that happened earlier; (usually plural) bad results of an action; importance or significance
ex: He didn't think about the consequences of his actions.
他沒有想過自己行為的後果。

en: n. a colorless gas in the air that people and animals need to breathe, and which is needed for fire to burn
ex: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis.
植物在光合作用時會釋出氧氣。

en: n. the way in which someone acts or treats other people; the way in which something works or reacts; the manner of acting
ex: The teacher praised the students for their good behavior.
老師稱讚學生們的良好行為。

en: n. a feeling of being grateful; the ability to understand and enjoy the value of something; an increase in value over time; a recognition of the good qualities of someone
ex: We gave her a gift to show our appreciation.
我們送她禮物表達我們的感激。

en: a. unpleasant or rude in a way that makes you feel upset; used for attacking; n. a planned attack or military operation
ex: His offensive remarks upset everyone at the meeting.
他無禮的言論使會議上的每個人都很不悅。

en: n. a person who does a job that needs special training; a person who is paid to play a sport; a. relating to work that needs special training; showing skill or experience
ex: He decided to become a professional soccer player.
他決定成為職業足球選手。

en: a. relating to seeing or sight; done using pictures or images; that can be seen; n. (plural) things like pictures or videos used to explain something
ex: The teacher used visual aids to explain the lesson.
老師用視覺輔助教具來講解課程。

en: n. comments or information about how good or useful something is, given in order to help improve it; a loud noise from a sound system caused by a loop; information returned about a result
ex: Please give me your honest feedback on my presentation.
請對我的簡報提供誠實的回饋。

en: n. a book that tells you how to do something or use a machine; a. done by hand and not by machine; needing physical work
ex: Please read the user manual before using the machine.
使用機器前請先閱讀使用手冊。

en: vi. to mention or speak about someone or something; to look at a book or source for information; to be connected with something; vt. to send someone to a person or place for help or information
ex: Please refer to page ten for more details.
更多細節請參閱第十頁。

en: vt. to run away from a dangerous place or situation; vi. to run away from danger; to escape from something
ex: Thousands of people fled the city during the war.
戰爭期間數千人逃離了這座城市。

en: n. a person who gives lectures, especially at a university; a person who gives a talk to a group of people
ex: The lecturer explained the topic with clear examples.
講師用清楚的例子解釋了這個主題。

en: n. a person who directs an orchestra or choir; a person who collects tickets on a bus or train; a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it; a guide or leader
ex: The conductor raised his baton and the orchestra began to play.
指揮舉起指揮棒，管弦樂團開始演奏。

en: n. a very young child who cannot yet walk or talk; a young child; a person who is just beginning to learn something; a. relating to babies; at an early stage of development
ex: The infant slept peacefully in its mother's arms.
嬰兒在媽媽的懷抱裡安詳地睡著了。

en: a. showing respect or politeness; polite and well-mannered; expressing admiration
ex: The students were respectful to their teacher.
學生們對老師很尊敬。

en: n. a date that is remembered each year because an important event happened on that day in the past; the date a couple got married; the yearly celebration of something
ex: They celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary last week.
他們上週慶祝結婚二十週年。

en: n. an animal that is a cross between a horse and a donkey, used for carrying heavy loads; a person who is very stubborn; a slipper without a back
ex: The mule carried heavy bags up the mountain trail.
騾子背著沉重的袋子走上山路。

en: n. a person who writes music; a person who writes something such as a poem or story; a person who settles disputes
ex: Mozart was a famous classical composer.
莫札特是一位著名的古典樂作曲家。

en: n. the act of causing great physical or mental pain to someone as a punishment or to get information; great pain or suffering; vt. to cause someone great pain; to cause someone to suffer in their mind; to twist or distort something
ex: Many prisoners were subjected to torture in the past.
過去許多囚犯曾遭受酷刑。

en: n. a round open container used for holding liquid, especially for washing; a large area of land that is lower than the land around it; the area drained by a river system
ex: She washed her face in the basin.
她在洗臉盆裡洗臉。

en: v. to stop or end; to stop doing something; n. an end to something (only in the phrase without cease)
ex: The company will cease operations at the end of the month.
公司將於月底停止營運。

en: a. gentle and not severe or strong; (of weather) not too cold or hot; (of food) not strongly flavored; not serious
ex: The weather is mild even in the middle of winter.
即使在隆冬，天氣也很溫和。

en: a. full of energy and new ideas; always changing and developing; (of a force) causing movement; n. a force that produces movement or change
ex: She is a dynamic leader who inspires her team.
她是個充滿活力的領導者，能激勵她的團隊。

en: n. a person or company that transports goods or people; a person or animal that can pass a disease to others without being ill; a company that provides communication services; a mail delivery person
ex: The airline is the largest carrier of passengers in the region.
這家航空公司是該地區最大的客運業者。

en: vt. to wake someone from sleep; to stir up a feeling or interest; vi. to wake up from sleep
ex: The loud noise wakened the baby.
巨大的聲響吵醒了嬰兒。
